_comment: ModelRouter v0 (TARGET-PLAN §3.2.1): the model registry and, per task class, the ordered backends to try. chat_voice and compact (decision 46) are bound in this build. debug_only entries exist in debug builds only. The router records the model the vendor reports serving, which can differ from the one asked for. context_window and max_output_tokens feed decision 46's context budget; xAI does not publish grok-voice-3.0's window, so the value is a conservative estimate.
